reason: The mapping to Articles 12, 19, and 26(6) of the EU AI Act provides a defensible and sufficiently complete regulatory basis. Article 12 covers logging of user interactions and system events, Article 19 addresses record-keeping and documentation, and Article 26(6) mandates logging of administrative actions, collectively supporting the control objective.
applicability_note: The EU AI Act applies to all AI systems, with stricter obligations for high-risk systems. The logging requirements are fundamental to ensuring traceability and accountability, which are core principles of the regulation.
challenge_comment: The challenge is to ensure that the logs are not only created but also protected from unauthorized access and tampering, which is implicitly covered by the general security and data protection principles of the AI Act.
